sentences.en: Calvin had become a chronic sufferer from ague and catarrh.
sentences.zh: 凯文成了长期患有疟疾和鼻炎的患者。

sentences.en: There is a chronic oversupply of rice in Japan.
sentences.zh: 日本大米供应过剩已经持续了很久。

sentences.en: Sami was a victim of chronic arsenic poisoning.
sentences.zh: 萨米是慢性砷中毒的受害者。

senses.zh: 经常发生的，复发的：frequent recurrence;习惯性的，不可能改变的：not likely, change

mnemonic: 词根记忆：chron（时间）+ic（…的）→时间的→长期的，慢性的
